appearance_facts.fact: Chart title: 'Year vs. Number of doctors per 1,000 inhabitants'
Single blue line with circular markers, representing 'Number of doctors per 1,000 inhabitants' over time.
Data point at year 2000.0 is at approximately 1.7 on the y-axis.
Data point at year 2017.5 is at approximately 2.5 on the y-axis.
